display.text:
import argparse
import os
from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate


def translate_text(text: str, target_language: str, source_language: str | None = None) -> str:
    client = translate.Client()
    result = client.translate(text, target_language=target_language, source_language=source_language)
    return result["translatedText"]


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("text")
    parser.add_argument("target_language")
    parser.add_argument("--source-language")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = translate_text(args.text, args.target_language, args.source_language)
    print(output)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not os.environ.get("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"):
        pass
    main()

+import argparse
+import os
+from typing import Iterable
+
+from google.cloud import translate_v2 as translate
+
+
+def batch_translate_texts(texts: Iterable[str], target_language: str, source_language: str | None = None) -> list[str]:
+    client = translate.Client()
+    items = list(texts)
+    if not items:
+        return []
+    results = client.translate(items, target_language=target_language, source_language=source_language)
+    if isinstance(results, dict):
+        results = [results]
+    return [result["translatedText"] for result in results]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("target_language")
+    parser.add_argument("texts", nargs="+")
+    parser.add_argument("--source-language")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    translated = batch_translate_texts(args.texts, args.target_language, args.source_language)

+        print(item)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if not os.environ.get("GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS"):
+        pass
+    main()
